goal: Inspect the live canonical Project Brain state using repository evidence. Read canonical/CANONICAL_POINTER.json and canonical/reconciliation/SAME_IDENTITY_INTEGRATION_FRONTIER_20260927_V1.json. Determine the exact current Superworker reality value, exact remaining causal blocker, and the next allowed causal action without inventing or repairing anything. Finish with a single JSON object containing schema PROJECT_BRAIN_CONSISTENCY_REPORT_V1, superworker_real, critical_blocker, next_action, and evidence_paths.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'

assert obj['schema']=='PROJECT_BRAIN_CONSISTENCY_REPORT_V1'

p=pathlib.Path('canonical/same_identity_worker/evidence/SI_REAL_MISSION_001__CONSISTENCY_REPORT.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('CONSISTENCY_REPORT_PERSISTED')
PY
